evidenceContract.historicalReuseRule: Only an unaffected checked row may retain historical raw output, and only when that output directly proves the narrower row and its DoD item carries Phase and Claim Source provenance tags.
evidenceContract.instruction: Execute every new or invalidated row again and append fresh evidence before checking its matching DoD item. A planned anchor marked PLANNED, NOT EXECUTED is not evidence.
